sections.Profile:
"Sea Scare" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1978. The game features a fantasy and mythological theme, with artwork depicting underwater scenes and sea creatures. Its playfield includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, three drop targets, a kick-out hole, and right dual inlanes. A notable feature is the mini-bagatelle on the playfield, adding an extra layer of skill and chance to the gameplay. The machine utilizes a wedge head cabinet design and offers an end-of-ball bonus feature.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Ocean, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy, Monsters
